65834bea23a0.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.

e11f1ce4747d.description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

The Role

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you’ll do

You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You’ll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.

What you’ll do

  • Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence
  • Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals
  • Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders
  • Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

What you’ll bring

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted. 

The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:

  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues
  • Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads
  • Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis
  • Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environment

Job Summary: The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design. You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Job Description: Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand. Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream. Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost. Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics. Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down. Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com. As a Senior Data Engineer at AeroVect, you will design, build, and scale the data infrastructure powering our autonomous ground support equipment (AGSE) operations. As our fleet expands across airports, you'll be responsible for ensuring that large volumes of vehicle telemetry, sensor data, and operational data are reliably ingested, processed, stored, and made accessible to engineering and operational teams. YOU WILL - Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of autonomous vehicle telemetry, sensor, and operational data. - Develop and operate reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, supporting both near-real-time monitoring and historical analysis. - Build and optimize cloud-based data infrastructure using AWS and modern distributed data processing technologies. - Develop systems to move data reliably from edge devices and on-premise infrastructure into cloud-based storage and processing environments. - Design and maintain data models, schemas, and storage architectures that enable efficient querying, analytics, and downstream engineering workflows. - Ensure data quality, consistency, availability, and observability across production pipelines. - Optimize data processing performance, storage efficiency, and infrastructure costs as fleet size and data volumes increase. - Collaborate with autonomy, software, and infrastructure engineers to support debugging, performance analysis, and continuous improvement of autonomous vehicle systems. - Build tools and infrastructure that make data easily accessible to engineering, product, and fleet operations teams. - Take end-to-end ownership of data infrastructure, from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting. YOU HAVE - 5+ years of experience

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole.   • Build automation to support datacenter fleets at scale.

  • Partner closely with Infrastructure Security to design and enforce trusted compute standards across the server lifecycle.
  • Work closely with our Networking team to ensure end-to-end connectivity across all sites.
  • Build and maintain tooling to track machine health, configuration, and operational status across the full datacenter fleet.

Minimum qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with server hardware, including rack deployment, cabling, troubleshooting, and understanding failure modes at scale.

e0d5c5cf59d4.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

The Community You Will Join

At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

301063dc5846.title: Senior Staff SRE, Architecture Engineering: Hosted Runners
301063dc5846.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

b8e697be13e5.title: Head of Data Science
b8e697be13e5.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Data Science, ML, and Data Platform team brings together data science, production ML, data engineering, and data platform to turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable products. These products help customers run safer, more efficient physical operations. As Head of Data Science, ML, and Data Platform, you will lead about 30 people through experienced managers and senior technical leaders, and report to the SVP of Engineering. You will decide where agents, foundation models, classical ML, and statistical methods belong at Samsara, and you will turn what you learn into how the whole organization works.

In this role, you will:

  • Define an AI-native strategy and rethink the roadmap from first principles as capabilities change. Choose what to build, buy, stop, and scale.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to take intelligence from experiment to deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement in customer experiences.
  • Build a trusted data foundation by making certified metrics, discoverable metadata, and traceable outputs available to people and agents across the organization, within clear permissions.
  • Own production and economic outcomes, including reliability, latency, inference and infrastructure cost, and human oversight. Make evaluation a core capability, with failure modes, uncertainty, and regressions visible during development.
  • Build a leadership team of managers and senior individual contributors and develop them. Hire people who combine scientific rigor, engineering ability, and a drive to keep learning.

Build the Path Forward

At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers.

What You'll Do

  • Frame open-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well-defined ML problems.
  • Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models.
  • Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits.
  • Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines.
  • Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics.
  • Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods.
  • Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low-latency inference and monitoring.

Who You Are

  • An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry.
  • Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models.
  • Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization.
  • You've run your methods on real robot hardware.
  • You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them.

Preferred

  • C++, and experience deploying models into a C++ or ROS 2 production stack.

Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE
Join Everpure’s Hydrogen Platform team as a Core Engineer to build the foundational platform and drive-support stack that powers next-generation, cloud-scale flash storage. You will bridge high-density DirectFlash Modules (DFMs) and standard hyperscale servers—turning raw QLC-based media into a resilient, serviceable enterprise platform running inside customer data centers. Collaborating directly with firmware, hardware, control plane, and performance engineering teams, you will qualify cutting-edge media, integrate new server architectures, and harden the stack for demanding real-world workloads.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect Core Platform & Lifecycle Software: Design, build, and maintain critical platform software for device discovery, health monitoring, firmware upgrades, and lifecycle operations so hyperscale customers experience reliable, uninterrupted storage at scale.

  • Build Automated Qualification & CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and evolve system-level validation pipelines and CI/CD infrastructure—defining functional, stress/soak, regression, and integration criteria—to safely accelerate the intake, rollout, and retirement of new firmware builds and drive types.

  • Lead Cross-Stack Triage & Root-Cause Resolution: Drive end-to-end debugging of complex failures across platform logs, Linux OS behavior, and device firmware alongside hardware and firmware teams, turning actionable diagnostics into permanent system-wide improvements.

  • Strengthen Observability & Operational Safety Rails: Enhance automation, telemetry, and automated safeguards for firmware and drive management to prevent regressions and ensure production readiness from initial hardware samples to global deployment.

6b3c9651e7d4.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
6b3c9651e7d4.description: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT RAMP LABS Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money. ABOUT THE ROLE Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step - Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping - Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output - Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up - Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack - Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works WHAT YOU NEED - Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped - Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference - Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production - Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look

3dc9d2ae65e8.description: What success looks like in this role: Position Summary The Middleware Patching Engineer is the hands-on engineer who completes patch management work for enterprise middleware and application runtime platforms, including application servers, web servers, messaging platforms, and Java and .NET runtimes, across Windows and Linux environments. The engineer plans, tests, schedules, deploys, validates, and documents patches, and drives failed or overdue systems to closure. The engineer works with the Vulnerability Engineer to ensure middleware is patched according to priority and customer risk, and with the Patching Automation Engineer to ensure that whatever can be automated is automated. The engineer also coordinates with middleware engineers, application owners, change management, and the Windows and Linux Patching Engineers. Middleware engineers retain ownership of platform architecture and administration. Key Responsibilities Execute patching across on-premises and cloud middleware, such as Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle HTTP Server, Apache Tomcat, Red Hat JBoss EAP, Apache HTTP Server, Microsoft IIS, IBM MQ, and Java and .NET runtimes. Work with the Vulnerability Engineer to translate vulnerability findings into patch or upgrade plans, prioritized by severity, exploitability, application criticality, and customer risk; track vendor release cycles such as Oracle Critical Patch Updates and Apache and Red Hat advisories; and maintain routine and emergency schedules aligned with remediation timelines and customer requirements. Maintain an accurate inventory of middleware products, versions, patch levels, and bundled components such as Java runtimes; reconcile scanner results against it to find coverage gaps and identify unsupported or end-of-life versions. Review vendor patch documentation and prerequisites; coordinate regression testing with application owners across development, test, staging, disaster recovery, and production; and prepare implementation, validation, and backout plans with change records, approvals, and confirmed backups. Lead readiness and go/no-go reviews and perform or coordinate deployments in approved maintenance windows, using rolling restarts across clustered and load-balanced nodes, then verify applications, services, certificates, and integrations. 02b94f4462ab.title: Storage Platform Engineer
02b94f4462ab.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase runs millions of Postgres databases, and storage performance is now one of the biggest levers on how fast, reliable, and affordable they are. We're building a software-defined, NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform underneath Supabase Postgres. Postgres stays unmodified, and the new layer delivers near-local-NVMe performance with the durability and flexibility of networked storage. As the senior engineer driving storage, you'll own this effort end to end: the architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, integration into our compute platform, and operating the system in production. Your first goal is raw Postgres I/O performance at scale. In the longer term, the layer you build will provide the block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones behind database branching, fast restores, and instant resizes. Because it's software-defined, it will also travel with us as we expand beyond a single cloud provider into multi-cloud and colocated infrastructure. This is a foundational, high-ownership role. You'll set the technical direction for storage at Supabase and help grow the team around it. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Lead the architecture of Supabase's NVMe-oF storage platform, including evaluating and deciding between adopting existing software-defined storage and building on SPDK - Integrate networked block storage into our Kubernetes-based compute platform through CSI drivers and custom controllers, covering provisioning, attach/detach, resizing, and migration - Make Postgres fast on networked storage by profiling and tuning the full I/O path, from fsync, WAL, and checkpoints through the kernel block layer, NVMe/TCP, and the network - Design for durability and availability, including replication or erasure coding, failure domains, failover, and data-integrity verification - Build I/O isolation and QoS so that noisy neighbors can't degrade other tenants - Set performance and reliability SLOs, and build the benchmarking and observability to hold the system to them - Design the layer for block-level snapshots and copy-on-write clones, laying the groundwork for database branching - Keep the platform portable across AWS, other clouds, and bare-metal/colo - Write design docs, mentor engineers, and work closely with the Compute, Branching, Postgres, and Multicloud teams - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU MUST HAVE: - Have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and operating storage systems in production - Have built or operated distributed or software-defined block storage (for example Ceph RBD, Lightbits, Simplyblock, Portworx, LINSTOR/DRBD, or an in-house system) - Have hands-on experience with NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, including targets, initiators, multipath, and failover behavior - Have a deep understanding of

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.


We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. 2076c4d35068.description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Postgres Tooling to join our CLI team and help build the open-source tools developers use to change their Postgres schemas safely. You’ll join as a co-maintainer of pg-delta, our schema diff and migration engine, and grow into leading it. Given two databases, or a database and a folder of SQL files describing the schema you want, pg-delta works out the differences and generates the migration to get from one to the other. It powers supabase db diff, db pull, and declarative schemas, and it runs underneath Supabase’s platform, branching, and AI agent workflows. Every migration it generates is verified on a throwaway clone before it’s trusted, and it’s tested against 331 scenarios on PostgreSQL 14–18. We’re now working toward a stable, standalone 1.0 release for any Postgres developer, on Supabase or not. This is a correctness-first role. The SQL this tool generates runs against production databases, so privilege safety and avoiding data loss are non-negotiable. It’s a great fit for someone who loves Postgres at the catalog level, enjoys compiler-style problems, and thrives in async, fast-paced environments. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR In this role, you’ll: - Co-maintain pg-delta: review and merge changes, including PRs written by AI agents, and grow into its lead maintainer. - Own correctness: triage bug reports from GitHub and support, fix diff and dependency-ordering bugs, and extend test coverage across Postgres versions. - Make sure generated migrations are privilege-safe and never silently lose data, by detecting destructive changes and rewriting them into safe equivalents where possible. - Help take pg-delta to a stable 1.0: a public API with a semver contract, documentation, and broader coverage of Postgres extensions. - Work with the open-source community: triage issues, review outside contributions, and say no gracefully when a request doesn’t fit. - Work with the teams across Supabase that build on pg-delta, so migrations are generated and run the same way everywhere. - Write the design docs and technical strategy that set the tool’s direction, working async across teams. - Share the CLI team’s on-call rotation. Weekdays are covered follow-the-sun, and because we ship packaged software that users can roll back, pages are rare. GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security’s Operational Technology service offerings are perpetually evolving in response to emerging threats and diverse client needs. We are growing and are looking to hire an OT Security Engineer with an in-depth understanding of Securing Operational Technology. Knowledge of OT, IoT, network architecture, and cybersecurity is a must.

About the OT/IoT Security Services Practice

The OT/IoT Security Services practice protects the industrial systems our clients depend on in energy, water, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and other critical infrastructure sectors. We deliver in every GuidePoint Security region and provide the services behind GuidePoint Security's OT technology partnerships.

Most of the team came to security from the plant floor or the military: veterans and former engineers from utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, and nuclear power. They know what an operator is thinking when a consultant walks into the control room with a laptop, and safety and uptime come first on every job.

A typical client relationship starts with finding out what's actually on the OT network and where it's exposed. From there we design segmentation and controls that don't interrupt operations, and many clients stay with us for ongoing OT vulnerability management. The work in between includes OT risk assessments against ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, and the TSA security directives; OT penetration tests scoped for live environments; and deployment and tuning of OT visibility and secure remote access platforms.

OT has problems you won't find in IT security, like hunting for an attacker on a network that can't handle an active scan, or explaining a firewall change to someone who has to keep a turbine running. Every site is different, and that's a big part of why we stay.

What sets the practice apart

  • A multi-vendor OT lab with PLC hardware and several visibility and remote access platforms, so clients can compare them side by side before buying
  • Vendor-objective advice. We work with many platforms and can tell a client which one fits their environment
  • A fast-growing OT practice on track to become one of GuidePoint Security's top practices, with leadership support and the autonomy to shape the service catalog, lab, and team

28eba9c5dd90.description: Clinical Data Science Programmer, Chennai ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster. As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers. As a Clinical Data Science Programmer at ICON, you will develop and implement programming solutions that enhance the analysis of clinical trial data. What You Will Do: You will take responsibility for clinical data science deliverables, applying your skills to ensure quality and efficiency. Key responsibilities include: Developing and validating statistical programming code to support data analysis and reporting for clinical trials. Collaborating with data scientists and statisticians to understand data requirements and analytical needs. Ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory guidelines in programming practices. Creating and maintaining documentation for programming processes, code, and outputs. Participating in the review of analysis datasets and final reports to ensure accuracy and completeness. Your Profile: You will bring relevant clinical data science experience, along with the following qualifications and skills. Required qualifications and experience: Degree in computer science, statistics, life sciences, or a related field. Experience in programming, preferably within a clinical research environment. Proficiency in programming languages such as SAS, R, or Python, with a strong understanding of statistical analysis. Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality programming outputs. Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based. Rewards & Benefits ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development. Benefits may include: Competitive base salary and performance related incentives Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable Retirement and pension plans Life assurance and disability coverage Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways Benefits may vary depending on role and location. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tailscale, you’ll be the bridge between our technical capabilities and the needs of our most strategic customers. You will work directly with customers to ensure their success with Tailscale’s products, helping them get onboarded, driving their long-term adoption, and providing expert technical guidance throughout their journey. This role requires a combination of technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and an empathetic customer-centric approach to ensure customers are fully empowered to leverage the power of Tailscale. The role will report directly to the Team Lead, Customer Success Engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the onboarding process for new strategic customers, ensuring they quickly understand and adopt Tailscale. Provide training and resources that set customers up for long-term success.
  • Offer technical support for customers, diagnosing and resolving issues across Tailscale's platform. Assist with configuration, integration, and troubleshooting to ensure smooth implementation.
  • Conduct QBRs with customers to review usage, success metrics, and future goals. Use these touchpoints to identify opportunities for deeper engagement and horizontal expansion.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor. Help customers optimize their use of Tailscale by identifying best practices, and by providing recommendations based on their specific use cases and desired business outcomes.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, relaying feedback and insights to the product and engineering teams to help improve the product and the customer experience.

e1d878d5aa34.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
e1d878d5aa34.description: About us GoTyme is a multi-country digital banking group with global ambitions, building simple and trusted money tools that help more people access financial services. We serve 23M+ customers through 2,000+ employees across seven locations: South Africa, the Philippines, Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, India, and Vietnam. GoTymeX is GoTyme’s Technology and Product Development Hub, building the engine behind the business. Our engineers, data scientists, product managers, and architects create and scale the platforms, products, and experiences that power GoTyme across markets. About the role We're looking for an AI/ML Engineer to join our Insights & Personalization pod within TymeX, a team building the intelligence layer that makes digital banking adaptive, transparent, and deeply personalized. This role is perfect for someone who understands that production ML in financial services isn't just about model accuracy; it's about building trustworthy, explainable systems that customers can rely on with their money. You'll design and deploy machine learning systems across the full stack, from transaction intelligence and behavioral pattern recognition to predictive forecasting, conversational AI, and agentic solutions. You'll be building production systems that customers interact with directly, making the impact of your work tangible and immediate. As part of the Tyme Group operating across multiple markets, you'll build systems that create compounding value as they learn from more data and usage, with the opportunity to see your work scale globally across our digital banking platforms. What you will do As an AI/ML Engineer, you'll work across the full ML lifecycle, from model design and experimentation to large-scale deployment and performance optimization, within a distributed, microservices-based, and cloud-native environment. You will: Design, build, and optimize AI/ML pipelines for real-time and batch inference, leveraging modern MLOps practices. Collaborate with data engineers and software developers to integrate models into TymeX's banking platform, ensuring reliability, monitoring, and version control. Research, prototype, and productionize models in areas such as credit scoring, fraud detection, transaction classification, personalization, and conversational AI. Implement robust model evaluation, A/B testing, and drift detection frameworks to ensure accuracy and stability over time. Contribute to internal frameworks and libraries to standardize ML development workflows across teams. Explore and evaluate emerging techniques in LLMs, Generative AI, and reinforcement learning applicable to TymeX's ecosystem. Mentor junior engineers and collaborate closely with product and infrastructure teams to ensure model readiness for global scale.

343b43ed2048.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the US or Canada (residents of Québec are not eligible for this position).

The Opportunity

About our platform

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.

The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.

c09f9923f0e6.title: Software Engineer 2 - ADEX
c09f9923f0e6.description:
About the Role

Enterprises of all sizes trust Abnormal's AI-native security products to stop cybercrime and protect critical communications, identities, and infrastructure in the cloud. Our products are data- and systems-intensive, operating at high scale and low latency across multiple clouds and regions.

As a Software Engineer II on the ADEX Team, you are a highly capable detection feature owner: you take a detection problem, come up with an idea, design a technical approach, and drive it end-to-end, from design and implementation through launch, operation, and continuous improvement. You will work with a world-class group of engineers, product managers, and data scientists to build and operate detection that is reliable, scalable, and AI-native by default.

This role focuses on impersonation detection, including brand, lookalike-domain, VIP and employee impersonation. It is ideal for an engineer who has already shipped meaningful production systems, wants more ownership and impact, and is excited to use AI to build detection that was not possible before.

About the Team

The Advanced Detection of EXtended threats (ADEX) is an attack-detection team inside Abnormal's Detection org. We own several of the highest-visibility detection surfaces at the company, spanning attachment-based attacks, fraud, and impersonation. We work the way an analyst would: we study the attacks that get through, understand the underlying pattern, and translate it into system-level detection enhancements that generalize beyond the individual attack.

We are also one of the most AI-forward teams at Abnormal. We build and operate LLM-based detection agents and treat internal AI tooling as a first-class deliverable. Every engineer here writes detection logic and builds AI agents. Impersonation is one of the most damaging and visible classes of attack we defend against, where even simple attacks that slip through erode customer trust, so this is a surface we hold to a very high bar.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate detection that is core to Abnormal's products, from initial design through rollout, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own detection projects end-to-end, including those that begin with a degree of ambiguity: scope loosely defined problems, identify risks, define milestones, and deliver reliably.
  • Analyze attacks that get through. Pull and study missed-attack data, read the messages the way an attacker and an analyst would, identify the underlying pattern, and translate it into detection enhancements or entirely new detection systems.
  • Write and tune detection logic using scored signals and attributes, add new signals across the pipeline, and drive changes to launch with a strong focus on minimizing false positives.
